en: Alola! You must be the trial-goer Kukui keeps talking about. I'm Mallow, one of Akala's trial captains.
My trial's up in the Lush Jungle, but you'll want to see Lana's at Brooklet Hill first. It's west off Route 5, just north of here.
Oh, and take this along. My Stoutland can sniff out things buried in the ground. It's registered in your Ride Pager now!
{player} registered Stoutland in the Ride Pager!
Have you tried the moomoo milk here? It's the best!
Tauros snorted and pawed at the ground.
Mudbray is rolling happily in the mud.
